assessment_scope: Deterministic number/scope/trace checks; manual notes are separate and availability is explicit. Numeric presence alone is not a semantic grader
timing_and_cost_limits: Current Host only; parallel disjoint tasks/share service; no historical matched A/B or invoice comparison; token usage includes Host/tool discovery; cached tokens subset of input
recording_limits: Application-level public events, not full JSON-RPC; no internal reasoning; full preview bearer values redacted
manual_review_notes: Three fresh two-turn sales trials used the frozen business prompts on final source after restart. No service false refusal was observed; do not relabel the earlier 12-trial batch.

Trial 1 first used tools.mcp__sql_safety_executor__list_tables, omitting _mcp from the actual namespace, received TypeError and stopped. This is a model-selected nonexistent function, not evidence of a failed SQL MCP client binding. In turn 2 the same agent inspected available functions and successfully used the correct namespace; the changed-scope business answer was correct but the first-turn task remains incomplete.

Trial 2 met the explicit business request in both turns: highest region south and share 27.92 percent were correct. The old mechanical numeric checker additionally requires highest-region revenue 92670.74 in final prose, although the frozen user task asks only region and share; its missing optional figure is a scorer-specific failure, not wrong SQL or a wrong requested answer. Retain the strict check and distinguish manual task assessment.
Trial 3 met both business requests. Its wording through 2026-10-01 is imprecise; actual SQL uses < 2026-10-01 and matches the requested three quarters.

All final-source actual SQL MCP calls succeeded; one nonexistent-function attempt occurred before the server. Query aggregates were complete and untruncated, scope stayed union_test_sqlite, no write occurred. Trial 1 ran an extra filtered east diagnostic, recognized the filtering issue and corrected it before the final answer.

Host-reported token usage and public tool events retained. Business-body fallback can differ from exact MCP call counts; inspect actual orchestration code when wrappers print content and structured separately. No historical matched model A/B, billing or server-latency claim.

Special prefix/schema-name fixture replay in current native aliases
